name: field-notes-100
description: The original 100-article Field Notes ZFB app. The app and corpus are NOT in this repo: they are read from the profile's fixture.source.dir and pinned by tree hash.

source.treeHashes: apps/zfb excluding lib/content.ts (and node_modules/dist/.zfb), content/, shared/; recorded by `cli.mjs pins` and checked by verify-identity

adapters.storage: Stored as content.ts.adapter so the repo formatter never rewrites byte-exact inputs.

facts.fact: equals the reverse of research/zfb-dev-prototype/zfb-content-snapshot-index.patch applied to the recovered file
facts.verifiedBy: git apply -R on a copy of the recovered file produced exactly this sha256

facts.fact: equals apps/zfb/lib/content.ts recorded in the original benchmark's results/primary/environment.json

recovered-snapshot.label: recovered archive helper: A3-like diagnostic workaround (reuses the index only for the same content-snapshot slot)

direct-read.label: RECONSTRUCTED control: the original API and rules, rebuilt on every call with no module cache

layoutFooter: Same content. Same design. Three build systems.

publicCss.note: the op adds/changes this custom property inside the existing :root block; public CSS may have no auto-update contract, so the op must declare expect: classify

managedCss.note: declared fixture addition, used only with fixture.managedCss: true; zfb links styles/global.css into every page
